title: Tighten logit softcap 15 -> 10
description: One line in GPT.forward: softcap = 15 -> 10; nothing else touched.
reflection: FLAT/slightly negative: val_bpb 0.986493 vs baseline 0.986277 (+0.0002, inside the ~0.0009 noise floor). Completely confound-free: params 71.3M, FLOPs/token 3.460347e8, peak VRAM 32.9GB, MFU 38.17%, 328.7M tokens / 2508 steps (baseline 331.5M / 2529). Combined with round 6 (softcap 30 => +0.0040), softcap=15 is at or very near the optimum of a clearly asymmetric curve: loosening costs 0.004, tightening by a comparable factor costs ~0. Final smoothed TRAIN loss rose to 2.775 (baseline ~2.7685) while val was unchanged -- i.e. the tighter cap did add regularization pressure, it just bought nothing on val. The output-head axis is now closed in both directions; the cell's remaining unprobed levers are the schedule constants (WARMDOWN_RATIO 0.5, FINAL_LR_FRAC 0.0, WARMUP_RATIO 0.0) and WINDOW_PATTERN.
